solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Innoculate"** is an incorrect spelling. (टीका लगाना) • **Example: **Health workers **inoculate** people to protect them from infectious diseases. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Immaculate **(निर्मल): Perfectly clean, neat, or tidy. • **Example:** Her house was **immaculate**, with not a speck of dust to be found. • **Immense **(विशाल): Extremely large or great. • **Example: **The** immense** size of the universe is beyond human comprehension. • **Irreverent** (असम्मानजनक): Showing a lack of respect for people or things that are generally taken seriously. • **Example:** The comedian's** irreverent** jokes often offended the audience. 56:T8ba,
